props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the field's root.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value of an uncontrolled field. `null` reads as no value.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text, rendered as `Field.Description`.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The error message, rendered as `Field.Error` while it is truthy. Pass `isInvalid` with it, so the input is marked invalid too. Without it, the field shows its own error, such as one `Form` holds under its `name` or the browser's constraint message.

props.name: filter
props.description: Keeps digits only, forwarded to the inner `Input`. Only digits reach `onChange`. It sets `inputMode="numeric"` unless you pass `inputMode`. `maxLength` counts digits when the browser sends a cancelable `beforeinput` on a type with a selection API, so a pasted `912 34 567` fits `maxLength={8}` whole. Under `type="email"`, and for autofill that sends no cancelable `beforeinput`, the browser cuts the text to `maxLength` first. There a pasted `912 34 567` becomes `912345`. Input's `filter` lists the types and paths.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the whole field and the input.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon at the input's end. Mark it `aria-hidden` when it only decorates.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and the input.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid, with the invalid look.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Shows a spinner at the end of the label row. The row shows even without `label`.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Makes the input read-only, with the muted read-only fill.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Makes the input required, so the browser's constraint check blocks an empty submit.

props.name: isSuccess
props.description: Shows a check at the end of the label row, in place of the `isPending` spinner. The row shows even without `label`.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, rendered as `Field.Label`. Without it, name the field with `aria-label`.

props.name: name
props.description: The input's `name`, which it submits under, and under which `Form` routes its errors.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the input's text on every edit.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The input's placeholder text.

props.name: size
props.description: The input's control size. `default` is the md control size, and `sm` the sm one. It replaces the native numeric `size` attribute.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, for a controlled field.

props.name: variant
props.description: The look. `card` puts the label, a large borderless input and the description beside it in a card. `inline` hides the input's border and fill until hover, focus or an invalid state. Unset is a plain `Input` under its label.
